summary.text: Supreme Moore Omokunde is a Democratic member of the Wisconsin State Assembly representing District 17, where he took office on January 4, 2021, and he is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election against Republican Charlene Abughrin.
He previously served on the Milwaukee County Board of Supervisors.

paragraphs.text: Supreme Moore Omokunde was born in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, and his career experience includes working with Citizen Action of Wisconsin.
He represented District 10 on the Milwaukee County Board of Supervisors from 2015 to 2021.
Omokunde joined the Assembly in January 2021, and for 2025-2026 he was assigned to the Energy and Utilities, Jobs and the Economy, and Regulatory Licensing Reform committees.
